items.title: Define Experience Layer leaf types and a minimal learning-store that reads/writes .lattice/learning/ with zero outward imports
items.context: core/experience-layer-types.ts (FindingSignal/LearningSignal/derived-cache types) + core/learning-store.ts (ensure .lattice/learning dir; read/write finding-signals.json). Only node:, ./, ../ imports within the module; never ../../ out of the module.
items.userSees: Build is clean; the new modules exist and the smoke asserts the learning-store round-trips finding-signals.json and that the module set has zero cross-module imports.

happy.desc: learning-store round-trip: write a FindingSignalCache via writeFindingSignals then readFindingSignals returns identical data -> deepEqual match; WHY: proves atomic write + read path works end-to-end
ensureLearningDir on fresh temp dir -> .lattice/learning/ directory is created; WHY: proves idempotent directory creation on first-run worktree

edge.desc: readFindingSignals when finding-signals.json does not exist -> returns null or empty default, never throws; WHY: graceful degradation on fresh project with no prior cache
static import scan of core/experience-layer-types.ts and core/learning-store.ts -> zero imports matching ../../ pattern; WHY: enforces usage-ledger isolation bar (zero outward imports)
writeFindingSignals to path where .lattice/learning/ does not yet exist -> auto-creates directory hierarchy and writes valid JSON; WHY: covers first-run scenario end-to-end

adversarial.desc: readFindingSignals when finding-signals.json contains malformed JSON -> returns null or throws a clear parse error, never corrupts state or crashes process; WHY: resilience to hand-edited or truncated cache files
concurrent writeFindingSignals calls from two async contexts -> file is never left truncated or empty, last writer wins with valid JSON; WHY: atomic write prevents data loss under race conditions

items.title: Implement finding-signals derivation reading findings through store.readFindings (port), not raw findings.json
items.context: core/finding-signals.ts: aggregate findings by localSignature = category + signatureTag? + fileKind + lifecyclePhase; compute counts, signalScore = positive/(positive+negative+1), support; write the derived cache. Read findings via the finding subsystem accessor store.readFindings, never JSON.parse of findings.json.
items.userSees: The smoke seeds findings via the store and asserts finding-signals.json contains the aggregated signals with correct signalScore/support and that derivation used the store accessor.

happy.desc: deriveFindingSignals with two findings sharing same localSignature (category=security, signatureTag=XSS, fileKind=ts, lifecyclePhase=review) where one is fixed_resolved and one is false_positive_dismissed -> produces single signal with signalScore = 1/(1+1+1) = 0.333..., support = 2; WHY: proves aggregation + formula correctness on the main path

deriveFindingSignals reads findings via store.readFindings accessor, never via direct JSON.parse of findings.json -> smoke verifies the store accessor path was used; WHY: enforces the port-based read contract (architectural boundary)

edge.desc: deriveFindingSignals with zero findings -> produces empty signals array, signalScore never NaN or undefined; WHY: zero-sample edge case must not produce arithmetic errors
single finding (fixed_resolved) -> signalScore = 1/(1+0+1) = 0.5, support = 1; WHY: single-hit edge shows high score but low support, verifies support=1 is surfaced
finding with signatureTag absent -> localSignature degrades to category+fileKind only (coarse aggregation); WHY: proves graceful degradation when signatureTag not yet captured
partially_mitigated outcome contributes 0.5 to positive count -> signalScore reflects fractional positive; WHY: verifies the 0.5 weighting rule from the plan

adversarial.desc: findings with corrupt/missing required fields (no category, no fileKind) -> derivation skips or handles gracefully, never throws unhandled exception; WHY: real findings data may have legacy or malformed entries
findings.json is missing entirely (store.readFindings returns empty) -> derivation produces empty cache, does not throw; WHY: fresh project with no findings history must not break derivation

items.title: Register the derived cache and learning log as materialHash-excluded runtime artifacts (gate-safety)
items.context: runtime-artifact-registry.ts: add entries for .lattice/learning/finding-signals.json and .lattice/learning/learning-log.jsonl as materialHash:exclude, volatile:true, repairable. This is the load-bearing gate-safety lever.
items.userSees: The smoke asserts that writing finding-signals.json leaves currentMaterialHash() unchanged (the derived cache is excluded from gate material hashing).

happy.desc: runtime-artifact-registry contains entry for .lattice/learning/finding-signals.json with materialHash:exclude and volatile:true -> registry lookup confirms the entry exists with correct properties; WHY: proves the cache is excluded from gate material hashing

runtime-artifact-registry contains entry for .lattice/learning/learning-log.jsonl with materialHash:exclude and volatile:true -> registry lookup confirms; WHY: proves the learning log is also gate-excluded

currentMaterialHash() before writing finding-signals.json equals currentMaterialHash() after writing -> hash unchanged; WHY: the load-bearing gate-safety property proving cache writes do not pollute gate freshness

edge.desc: writing finding-signals.json when file did not previously exist -> currentMaterialHash still unchanged; WHY: creation (not just overwrite) must also be excluded
writing learning-log.jsonl (append) -> currentMaterialHash unchanged; WHY: log appends must also be excluded from gate hashing

adversarial.desc: write finding-signals.json then delete it then check currentMaterialHash -> hash remains same as before write; WHY: create-then-delete cycle must not leave ghost hash pollution
overwrite finding-signals.json with different content multiple times -> currentMaterialHash unchanged throughout; WHY: repeated writes with varying content must all be excluded, not just the first

items.title: Add a committed smoke test + npm script proving derivation, the unchanged-materialHash property, and zero outward imports; no regression
items.context: tasks/experience-layer-finding-signals-smoke.ts + package.json test:experience-layer-finding-signals script. Hermetic temp dir + env restore. Assert: derivation correctness, currentMaterialHash unchanged after cache write, zero cross-module imports out of the module, build clean.
items.userSees: npm run test:experience-layer-finding-signals exits 0 with 'smoke passed'; the committed verifier prints TOTAL N | PASS N | FAIL 0.

happy.desc: npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-finding-signals exits 0 and stdout contains smoke passed; WHY: proves the committed smoke test runs successfully end-to-end
smoke test uses hermetic temp dir and restores env -> no leftover .lattice/learning/ in project root after run; WHY: proves test isolation, no side effects on real project state
npm --prefix packages/main run build exits 0 with no new type errors -> build clean after all changes; WHY: no regression from new module additions

edge.desc: smoke asserts zero-sample derivation (no findings seeded) -> signalScore is 0, not NaN, signals array empty; WHY: covers the zero-sample edge case within the committed test
smoke asserts single-hit finding -> signalScore computed correctly with support=1 displayed; WHY: covers single-hit edge within the committed test

static import scan within smoke asserts zero outward imports (no ../../ in core/experience-layer-types.ts, core/learning-store.ts, core/finding-signals.ts) -> count is 0; WHY: enforces the usage-ledger isolation bar as a committed regression test

adversarial.desc: introduce a fake ../../ import in one of the experience-layer modules then run the static scan portion of the smoke -> smoke detects it and fails; WHY: proves the static scan is not vacuously true (would catch a real violation)
run the smoke test twice in succession -> both runs exit 0, no stale temp dir conflicts; WHY: proves hermetic cleanup is complete, no inter-run contamination
